A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a DT is a representation of a product and/or process in silico that can be used to predict the behavior of a physical system and to support decision-making.
DTs are a promising technology with a high potential of becoming a key enabling technology in the (bio-)pharmaceutical industry.

the DT concept is not a new one, and the biopharmaceutical industry is ready to embrace the concept.
